name: gepa_sme_gold
description: Clean GEPA re-opt aligned with the SME: seed = hand style guide v6.0, train/dev = SME gold splits (in-domain imaging, SME-corrected register; held-out test untouched), reward = multi-reference spacing-normalised exact + chrF with frozen+enforced hard rules and the contrast-fidelity penalty, reflection = Opus 5 via the Agent-SDK provider.
